Container.Name: HomeSeer
Container.Overview:
HomeSeer 4 home automation server (Linux / Mono). Not supported, sponsored or affiliated with HomeSeer Technologies.
HomeSeer is installed into the appdata folder on first start and can update itself from within the HomeSeer UI; updating or recreating this container never downgrades an existing install.
Set a fixed IP address (Fixed IP address field) on the br0 network; HomeSeer then answers on port 80 of that IP and LAN discovery (mDNS, Z-NET, HS-Touch) works.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: HomeSeer application, configuration, data, logs and backups.

Config.Name: Web UI (HTTP)
Config.Description: HomeSeer web interface. (On br0 the container uses its own IP, so port mappings do not apply; only change this when using bridge, e.g. 8080, since Unraid uses port 80.)

Config.Name: Local Credentials
Config.Description: Only needed if HomeSeer requires a login for local (localhost) connections: 'user:password'. Used to shut HomeSeer down cleanly when the container stops.

Config.Name: Force Reinstall
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to re-extract the bundled HomeSeer version over the appdata folder on next start (your config and data are kept). Set back to 'false' afterwards.

Config.Name: Z-Wave / Serial Device
Config.Description: Optional USB serial device (Z-Wave/Zigbee stick). Use host:container form for a stable path, e.g. /dev/serial/by-id/usb-XXXX:/dev/ttyUSB0. Leave blank if not used.
